description: Terminal-Bench style git hygiene: three different old commits leaked a deploy key, a db password and an api token; rewrite the history of repo/ so no object anywhere contains any marker or fragment while every tracked file stays byte-identical. Needs git on PATH and in the run's --auto-approve (not in the default set).

criteria: No object anywhere in repo/.git (reachable or not) contains any of the three markers or their fragments, every tracked file is byte-identical to the golden tree, and README.md and check.py are untouched.
